dialogues.jp:
テーブルの上に包みが置かれ、結び目をほどく
と、大きな弁当箱が姿を現す。
dialogues.en:
A big cloth-wrapped box is on the table in front of me, and
I can see the lunchbox inside as I unwrap it.
dialogues.text:
A big cloth-wrapped box is on the table in front of me, and
I can see the lunchbox inside as I unwrap it.

dialogues.jp: ――と、ここまではいつもと一緒だったのだが。
dialogues.en: ......Everything seemed normal up until that point.
dialogues.text: ......Everything seemed normal up until that point.

dialogues.jp: （あれれ？）
dialogues.en: (Huh?)
dialogues.text: (Huh?)

dialogues.jp:
｛ふた／蓋｝を開けると、いつもと微妙に雰囲気の違うお
かずが目に映る。
dialogues.en:
When I opened the lid, I noticed that the food looked
different to normal.
dialogues.text:
When I opened the lid, I noticed that the food looked
different to normal.

dialogues.jp: たこさんウィンナーじゃ……ない。
dialogues.en: I don't see any cute sausages......
dialogues.text: I don't see any cute sausages......

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「どうぞ……」
dialogues.en: "Go ahead......"
dialogues.text: "Go ahead......"

dialogues.jp: 目の前に箸が差し出された。
dialogues.en: Moe-sempai passed me the chopsticks.
dialogues.text: Moe-sempai passed me the chopsticks.

dialogues.jp: 「え……あ、どうも……」
dialogues.en: "What? Oh, thank you......"
dialogues.text: "What? Oh, thank you......"

dialogues.jp:
差し出された箸を受け取りながら、“はてな？”
と傾げる。
dialogues.en: I tilted my head as I took the chopsticks.
dialogues.text: I tilted my head as I took the chopsticks.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「どうしたんですか？」
dialogues.en: "What is it?"
dialogues.text: "What is it?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「え、いや……今日は食べさせてくれないのか
　なと思って……」
dialogues.en: "Oh, umm...... you usually feed me......"
dialogues.text: "Oh, umm...... you usually feed me......"

dialogues.jp: 自分で言っててちょっぴり恥ずかしくなる。
dialogues.en: I felt embarrassed for saying this.
dialogues.text: I felt embarrassed for saying this.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「あの、ごめんなさい…。今日はちょっと気分
　がよくなくって……」
dialogues.en: "Oh, I'm sorry...... I don't feel very good today......"
dialogues.text: "Oh, I'm sorry...... I don't feel very good today......"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「そうなの？　大丈夫？」
dialogues.en: "Really? Are you okay?"
dialogues.text: "Really? Are you okay?"

dialogues.jp:
関係あるのかなぁ、とも思うけど、確かに具合
の悪いときには、そんなイチャつく気にはなら
ないか……。
dialogues.en:
I guess you don't feel like flirting when you aren't feeling
very well......
dialogues.text:
I guess you don't feel like flirting when you aren't feeling
very well......

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「はい。｛・・・・・・／身体のほうは｝大丈夫ですから……」
dialogues.en: "Yes...... My body feels okay......"
dialogues.text: "Yes...... My body feels okay......"

dialogues.jp:
ニッコリ微笑んでみせる萌先輩だけど、表情に
陰がみえる。
dialogues.en: She showed me a smile but still looked down.
dialogues.text: She showed me a smile but still looked down.

dialogues.en: "......Are you sure?"
dialogues.text: "......Are you sure?"

dialogues.jp:
少し気になったが、深く追及するのはやめて、
おかずに箸を伸ばすことにした。
dialogues.en:
I was concerned, but I decided not to go in depth, and
started eating.
dialogues.text:
I was concerned, but I decided not to go in depth, and
started eating.

dialogues.jp: 「ごちそうさまでした」
dialogues.en: "Thank you for the food."
dialogues.text: "Thank you for the food."

dialogues.jp: 箸を置き、顔の前で手を合わせる。
dialogues.en:
I put the chopsticks down and put my hands together in front
of me.
dialogues.text:
I put the chopsticks down and put my hands together in front
of me.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「いえ」
dialogues.en: "You're welcome."
dialogues.text: "You're welcome."

dialogues.jp:
萌先輩はいつもの微笑みを見せて、ぱたぱた、
と弁当箱をしまうと、錠剤の入ったビンを取り
出す。
dialogues.en:
She showed me her usual smile and put the lunchbox away.
Then she took out the bottle of pills.
dialogues.text:
She showed me her usual smile and put the lunchbox away.
Then she took out the bottle of pills.

dialogues.jp: 「あれ？　それって前に飲んでいた栄養剤？」
dialogues.en: "Huh? Those are vitamins you were taking before, right?"
dialogues.text: "Huh? Those are vitamins you were taking before, right?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「はい」
dialogues.en: "Yes."
dialogues.text: "Yes."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: （……けど、ほんとに栄養剤なのかな？）
dialogues.en: (......But are they really vitamins?)
dialogues.text: (......But are they really vitamins?)

dialogues.jp: なんとなく口にはしづらかった。
dialogues.en: I couldn't really ask her.
dialogues.text: I couldn't really ask her.

dialogues.jp: 女の子って、男と違って色々あるだろうし……。
dialogues.en: I know that girls go through a lot......
dialogues.text: I know that girls go through a lot......

dialogues.jp:
萌先輩は錠剤を口に含み、購買で買ってきた
ジュースと一緒に飲み込む。
dialogues.en:
Moe-sempai put a pill in her mouth and swallowed with the
juice she bought from the store.
dialogues.text:
Moe-sempai put a pill in her mouth and swallowed with the
juice she bought from the store.

dialogues.jp: 別段なにが変わったわけでもないのだけれど。
dialogues.en: Nothing seemed to be different.
dialogues.text: Nothing seemed to be different.

dialogues.jp: 何か、胸騒ぎがした。
dialogues.en: However, I felt uneasiness in my heart.
dialogues.text: However, I felt uneasiness in my heart.

dialogues.jp: ◆元気がないぞ◆
dialogues.en: ◆Moe-sempai isn't feeling well◆
dialogues.text: ◆Moe-sempai isn't feeling well◆

dialogues.jp:
萌先輩と一緒の食事。しかし、何故か彼女は元
気がないようだった。
dialogues.en:
I had lunch with Moe-sempai. However, she seemed to be down
today.
dialogues.text:
I had lunch with Moe-sempai. However, she seemed to be down
today.
